description: This script automates updating GitHub pull request statuses and comments with documentation deployment links based on the deployment process and PR commits.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Configuration class for GitHub repository, token, deployment URL, commit SHA, run ID, and deployment state.

classes.name: LinkData
classes.description: Data model representing links to previous, preview, and English versions of documentation pages.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that updates PR statuses, generates documentation links, and posts comments with deployment info.
